name: Multiband, 4 bands, 4:1 at -20 dB
notes: Fancy MultiComp against Convergence Free (Cut Through Recordings, free, four bands). The same four bands on each: crossovers at 120 Hz, 1.2 kHz and 6 kHz, every band 4:1 at -20 dB, attack 10 ms, release 100 ms. Convergence's names are guesses until checked with FancyBench params. GLUECOMP-3B is left out: it has one Adapt knob instead of a threshold and ratio, so it can't be set to match.
